purpose: Visual identity brainstorming; mockup screens are not implemented or approved UI.
prompts:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a high-craft visual identity concept board for a personal training app connecting an independent trainer and their clients: appointments, workout programs, recording sets, mutual support. This is a design exploration, not a finished brand. Landscape composition, crisp professional art direction, flat front-facing design board, generous whitespace, beautifully arranged. White and very light cool grey background, near-black ink; existing app uses bold geometric Montserrat-like headings and readable Inter-like UI. Two thirds of the board showcase the identity, one third shows ONE large legible mobile app screen applying it. Small supporting studies demonstrate consistent shapes rather than unrelated logos. App UI should be realistic and calm, with large date/time, training title, trainer name and clear black button. Use Russian text precisely, sparingly. No invented brand name. No stock fitness photos, muscular superheroes, dumbbell logos, gradients, glossy 3D, clutter, illegible tiny text, watermarks or imitation of Headspace characters. The identities must be welcoming to adults and feel authored, confident and distinctive.
Direction 01, title text "ПЕТЛЯ". Create an original expressive mascot from ONE thick continuous elastic black ribbon forming an asymmetric open-centered loop, with a distinctive leaning silhouette and two tiny cream oval eyes on one section. It is a flat graphic ribbon with consistent width and playful tension, not a furry creature, not a ghost, not an infinity logo. The negative space within the loop is important. Large hero loop standing with quietly curious body language. Three smaller poses along the bottom: stretching tall, leaning supportively, curled up resting; all visibly the same character. A small app icon crop shows the loop clearly in white on black. Near-monochrome palette. On the phone screen put "Сегодня", "18:30", "Силовая тренировка", "Тренер · Алина", button "Открыть тренировку". A small resting loop occupies a modest welcome illustration area above the appointment, never obscuring text. Overall emotion: resilient, calm, tactile, gently witty. Make the silhouette iconic and the graphic execution exceptionally refined.

Direction 02, title text "ДУЭТ". Create two original complementary flat geometric characters who express mutual support: one a tall softly bent charcoal arch with small legs and tiny eyes; the other a compact rounded pale slate-grey wedge with small legs and tiny eyes. Both equal in agency and visual importance, neither childlike nor subordinate. Large hero scene shows them leaning toward each other and meeting their hands into an understated high five, their counterbalanced poses forming a distinctive paired silhouette. Three small vignettes below show the SAME pair greeting, stretching side by side, and sitting relaxed together. Include a tiny compact two-shape app icon study. Black/white/cool grey with clear silhouettes and expressive minimal faces; no multicolor blob family. Phone screen text: "Мы в команде", "Алина", "Ваш тренер", "Ближайшая тренировка", "18:30", button "Открыть план". One small pair illustration at the top of the phone, rest of interface is precise and quiet. Adult editorial illustration with warmth and a recognizable graphic system.

Direction 03, title text "СВОЙ РИТМ". NO mascot, NO faces. Create a sophisticated athletic graphic identity built from bold vertical black strokes, rounded rectangular beats, fine pause marks, and intervals of negative space. The hero graphic is a striking horizontal rhythm composition with varied heights and intentional spacing, suggesting movement, repetition and recovery, NOT an audio equalizer or medical ECG. Use black, warm white and ONE restrained cobalt blue accent restricted to the decorative identity. Include a small program cover study with text "СИЛА", a square app icon containing three unmistakable rhythm marks, and a minimal weekly strip with 3 filled workout markers and open rest intervals. Do not imply continuous streak requirements. Phone screen uses title "В своём ритме", "Эта неделя", "3 тренировки", "Следующая · четверг", "18:30", button "Открыть тренировку". Graphic band at top, calm black/white interface. Premium contemporary sports editorial typography, assertive yet friendly, excellent proportion and whitespace. Avoid generic SaaS cards or ring dashboards.

Direction 04, title text "НА ПОЛЯХ". Build an authored shared training notebook identity: crisp black typography paired with expressive confident black ink marginal drawings, lively handwritten large numerals, spare graphite hatching and small hand-drawn curved underlines. White paper with extremely subtle texture, no yellow vintage journal, no scrapbook mess. Main hero illustration: an adult woman trainer and an adult male beginner in simple sportswear leaning over the SAME open training notebook, one pointing to a page, both engaged equals. Draw figures in economical sophisticated editorial linework, distinctive expressive posture, human warmth, no photorealism or anatomy instruction. Supporting illustrations: a folded towel, an open notebook with a handwritten "3", a tiny relaxed stretching figure, all in the same line language. Phone is mainly crisp typeset UI with handwritten accents carefully placed in margins: "Хорошая работа", "Тренировка записана", "Приседания", "3 × 12", "Тяга", "3 × 10", button "Готово". A small drawing celebrates the recorded session quietly. The composition should feel personal, crafted and sporting, not a school worksheet or productivity template.
revisionPrompt: Edit this identity concept board. CRITICAL SINGLE CHANGE: remove the entire dark smoky gradient/vignette background and ALL glow, spotlights and fog. Replace background across the whole board with uniform solid opaque white (#FFFFFF). Make every heading and supporting caption dark charcoal and clearly legible against white. Keep the same direction, characters, identity graphics, phone screen, Russian typography content, composition and layout. The black character silhouettes must be clearly visible on WHITE. Flat editorial board, absolutely no dark background, no gradient, no texture overlay, no vignette anywhere. Preserve the phone screen's white background. No other conceptual redesign.
